thread:
mica: Heads-up — SolusHealth intake. They want an instruct-tuned variant with 64k context, int4 quant to reduce cost, and strict p95 latency target <= 300ms for single-turn summarization API. Also require private deployment (VPC + KMS). Can we triage priority?

raj: @mica thanks. Need to know: expected qps, average prompt length, and which eval suites to run. Any hard SLAs (uptime/retention)?

sarah: Customer says steady 10 qps peak, bursts to 30qps for end-of-day reports. Typical prompts are 2–6k tokens, outputs ~1k tokens. HIPAA and audit logs required, 90 day retention.

jordan: Putting this as high priority for the onboarding queue given HIPAA + latency needs. But int4 + 64k is a risky combo — we should run a small regression matrix first.

raj: Agreed. Proposed quick plan: 1) Baseline: run existing x-tuned-70b (fp16, stock) on 64k prefix with the customer's prompt set; 2) Quant experiments: int8->int4 PTQ/QLoRA variants; 3) Quality evals: summarization (XSum-like), clinical note extraction, and instruction-following probes; 4) Latency/cost: measure p50/p95 & tokens/sec on dedicated smallest GPU we expect to allocate.

mica: timeline? They want a pilot in 2 weeks.

raj: We can get a baseline and first int8 run in 4 days. int4 regression + mitigations 7–10 days. If we hit major quality regressions on summarization, fallback policy: serve fp16 for prompts flagged as high-risk via a lightweight classifier.

sarah: For private deployment we need to confirm KMS integration and that audit logs are forwarded to their SIEM. I'll open the infra ticket.

onboard-bot: Created ticket INF-1229 for VPC/KMS onboarding and OB-451 for model intake (linked to INF-1229).

raj: Quick note on experiments — copy of quant test command:
```
# run quant eval harness
python eval/quant_bench.py --model x-tuned-70b --quant int4 --ctx 65536 --tasks summarization,clinical --batch 1 --device cuda:0
```
Expect to see KV cache memory pressure; if OOM, we'll try chunked attention or offload cache to CPU.

mica: If we see regression in ROUGE/BLEU vs fp16 > 6 points on summarization, we treat that as blocking for int4 by default. Are we OK with that threshold?

raj: Seems reasonable. Also add a behavioral regression check: hallucination rate on clinical entity extraction must not increase by >3%.

jordan: Add operational checklist for rollout: canary 1% (private infra), monitor quality commit (eval set), automatic fallback to fp16 for any route exceeding quality or latency thresholds, and an on-call paging rule for regression alerts.

sarah: I'll collect the customer's eval prompts and sanitized PHI examples and DM them to @raj and @mica.

mica: Thanks. For prioritization: marking as P1 intake due to HIPAA + SLAs. @raj assemble the first-run benchmark and post results in this thread.

raj: Will do. Starting baseline run now — posting initial numbers within 24h.

onboard-bot: Note: tagging thread with labels [customer:onboarding] [priority:P1] and linked tickets OB-451, INF-1229.

mica: :thumbsup: Also let's schedule a 30min sync after the baseline to decide whether to proceed with int4 or plan fallback variants (int8/quant-aware finetune).
